title: RA information determination for RA report and RLF report

entities.name: RA Information Determination Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE sets the content in ra-InformationCommon for random access reports and RLF reports based on the random access procedure parameters and conditions.

entities.name: ra-InformationCommon
entities.description: Information element containing random access procedure parameters and configuration details for reporting purposes.

entities.name: 4-step Random Access
entities.description: Random access procedure using 4-step contention-based or contention-free random access resources.

entities.name: 2-step Random Access
entities.description: Random access procedure using 2-step contention-based or contention-free random access resources with msgA transmission.

entities.name: Contention Based Random Access
entities.description: Condition where random access resources are used in contention-based random access procedure.

entities.name: Contention Free Random Access
entities.description: Condition where random access resources are used in contention-free random access procedure.

entities.name: On-demand System Information Request
entities.description: Condition where the purpose of random access procedure is to request on-demand system information.

entities.name: SS/PBCH Block Associated Random Access
entities.description: Condition where random-access resource used is associated to a SS/PBCH block.

entities.name: CSI-RS Associated Random Access
entities.description: Condition where random-access resource used is associated to a CSI-RS.

entities.name: perRAInfoList
entities.description: List containing parameters associated to individual random-access attempts in chronological order.

relations.description: The procedure includes setting the content in ra-InformationCommon.
ra-InformationCommon contains parameters for 4-step random access resources.
ra-InformationCommon contains parameters for 2-step random access resources.
Condition guards which parameters are set in ra-InformationCommon for contention-based RA.
Condition guards which parameters are set in ra-InformationCommon for contention-free RA.
Condition guards setting of intendedSIBs and ssbsForSI-Acquisition in ra-InformationCommon.
The procedure includes setting parameters in perRAInfoList for individual random-access attempts.
Condition guards setting of SSB-related parameters in perRAInfoList.
Condition guards setting of CSI-RS-related parameters in perRAInfoList.
